## Claim checks
- [ ] Every factual claim has an appropriate source.
- [ ] Date, geography, and units are clear.
- [ ] CO₂ and CO₂e are not used interchangeably.
- [ ] Prototype is not described as certified or complete.
- [ ] Uncertainty and exclusions are explained.
- [ ] Language does not shame or rank individuals.
- [ ] Asset and data reuse rights have been checked.
